expectations.text: Asks the user questions or offers options with trade-offs and a recommendation, rather than just dictating one design
expectations.evidence: Dictates a modular monolith with Postgres; no options with trade-offs. Only a short open-questions list at the end.

expectations.text: Defines layers with a job and a forbidden job for each
expectations.evidence: Layers have jobs; only UI ('No business rules') and data access ('queries and migrations only') hint at limits. API and services have no forbidden job.

expectations.text: Assigns each kind of data a single owner or writer
expectations.evidence: Lists modules and a permission policy in one place, but never assigns a single writer/owner per kind of data.

expectations.text: Plans an architecture file and asks for approval before saving it, or notes sensitive data and permissions as a design input
expectations.evidence: Treats medication/health data and permissions as design inputs (care circle roles, encryption, audit log). Architecture doc is recommended but no approval ask; passes on the 'or' clause.
